notes: Version 2.39 records Foundation 2.5. Foundation cites ENI Corollary 6 with its own premises on each projection (surjectivity, observables defined by the projection, a level not isomorphic to the one below), which the axioms A1-A4 do not supply and which are open for the strata proposed by the programme. The ENI entry and graph node present ENI as a motivation for Axiom A2, not a derivation of it: Foundation retains A2 as a local axiom because the ENI premises are not established for the local transition map. The effective metric read from the principal symbol of the limit operator is conditional on the spatial limit hypothesis [H-L] and on the open lifting hypothesis [H-lift] of Q5b. The Weil module of the supplied Heisenberg-Schrödinger carrier is written W, with blocks V_c; V_rho denotes only the spinor carrier C^2 supplied conditionally by O23. The Foundation entry, table row and graph node carry the new version and wording. The identifications F_n = V_rho in the FM-Note entry and in HeisenbergCarrierObstruction are not resolved in this version.
